desc: E-commerce content marketing strategy planner. Generates content calendars, topic ideas, and platform-specific strategies by analyzing customer reviews, trends, competitor content, and SEO opportunities. Two modes: (A) Build — create a full content strategy from scratch, (B) Audit — analyze existing content and find gaps. Supports TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Pinterest, blog/SEO, and Amazon A+. No API key required.
